sources.entry: MEDIAPRONET - Launch and discovery directory where builders list newly shipped startups, SaaS tools and online products, with a free read-only remote MCP server (https://mediapronet.com/api/mcp) for searching listings, reading profiles and finding alternatives from AI assistants, no API key. #free #mcp

summary.name: MediaProNet
summary.one_liner: MediaProNet is a launch and discovery directory where builders list newly shipped startups, SaaS tools and online products, with community voting and paid placement tiers.
use_cases: Launching a newly shipped startup or SaaS product
Finding alternatives to a software product
Giving AI assistants access to directory listings via MCP
Buying promotion for a product listing
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a directory where builders submit products and the community votes on what ranks higher. Listings are organised into curated collections by what users are trying to do, and profiles can be read by AI agents. Pricing is one-time per listing across Starter, Premium and Exclusive tiers, each with different category pin durations and homepage exposure. Credit packs (10 for $149, 25 for $299, 100 for $899) allow bulk submissions, with rejected listings refunding their credits. The listing in the aggregator notes a free, read-only remote MCP server for searching listings and finding alternatives without an API key.
notable: Free read-only remote MCP server at mediapronet.com/api/mcp, no API key needed (per aggregator listing)
Community voting ranks what's shipping today
Credit packs allow bulk submissions with automatic refunds for rejected listings
Listings reach AI agent feeds via MCP and llms.txt
caveats: Listing promotion is paid, one-time per tier; Starter listings are shown as Unverified and go live at least 7 days after submission
Tier features like pins and homepage placement are time-limited (7, 30 or 90 days)
